composition: horizontal diptych, warplanes layered over figural ground
description: Panoramic collage across two joined panels depicting multiple warplane silhouettes in top-down and side views layered over a pale yellow ground with loosely drawn figural torso forms. Concentric roundels, compact discs, and target rings are distributed throughout, accented with red, blue, and black vertical ribbon stripes.
title: Warplanes Over Torso
